title: Supplemental Allowances on Rental Property Service Contracts
content:
Supplemental allowance amounts of Rental Property Service Contracts. The code-violation, permit, haul-away and lead-safe allowances are per-request amounts; the refrigerant allowance is a per-term amount across the contract. An amount of $0.00 means the tier carries no such allowance.

| Allowance | What it pays toward | Appliance | Systems | Combo | Combo Plus | Multi-Unit Combo | Multi-Unit Combo Plus |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Code violation | correcting a code violation needed to complete covered work (per request) | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | $250.00 | $0.00 | $250.00 |
| Permit fees | permits the covered work requires (per request) | $0.00 | $100.00 | $100.00 | $250.00 | $100.00 | $250.00 |
| Haul-away | removing replaced equipment (per request) | $0.00 | $75.00 | $75.00 | $100.00 | $75.00 | $100.00 |
| Refrigerant | refrigerant recovery and recharge (per term, across the contract) | $0.00 | $100.00 | $100.00 | $250.00 | $100.00 | $250.00 |
| Lead-safe work | lead-safe work practices required in older housing that may contain lead paint (per request) | $0.00 | $0.00 | $100.00 | $150.00 | $150.00 | $250.00 |

(Column headings abbreviate the tier names Bridgewell Rental Appliance, Bridgewell Rental Systems, Bridgewell Rental Combo, Bridgewell Rental Combo Plus, Bridgewell Rental Multi-Unit Combo and Bridgewell Rental Multi-Unit Combo Plus.)

Bridgewell Rental Appliance carries no supplemental allowance of any kind; only the two Plus tiers carry a code-violation allowance.
